content: Tik te' xat'ax te 'ãmuk xexka mĩy
Yeyox te xe hãm'ãktux'ax hã hãmyũmmũgãhã', nũy Topa yõg hãpxopmã'ax yũmmũgã', nũy Topa yã' hep xop xohix xãnã 'ãktux, tu:
—Topa te yãy yõg tikmũ'ũn xat, ha' yĩpkox pip, ha kaxĩy hãpxexka 'ũm yõg tik te' xat'ax te 'ãmuk xexka mĩy, 'ũk-tok pit te yãytap-tup hah,
yĩ' tak te kãmãnat mõ'pok pu tikmũ'ũn xãnã', pãyã 'ap nũn putup'ah,
yĩy kãmãnat nõy mõ'pok, pu tikmũ'ũn pu hãm'ãktux, hu: “'Ãte 'ãmuk xexka mĩy tap, tu mũnũytut tak kix, xix mũnũytut kutok kix, xa nũ', nũy 'ãxit!” Kaxĩy.
—Pãyã tikmũ'ũn tep-tup nõg, tu yãy kuxop punethok, tup-tup-nõg. 'Ũpxet te' yõg hãpxa xexka ha' mõg, xi' nõy te' yõg mẽn ha' mõg,
ha tikmũ'ũn nõy te kãmãnat xop mũg, tu' kix kakixnãg, tu' kix ha mõktu' xakix.
Ha hãpxexka yõg tik te' xat'ax gãy xexkah, hu' xat, pu tu kummuk xop kix 'ũyãnãn tu', xi' yõg pip'ax mõ'xut kuxap hã', pu tu nõg.
Ha' xat'ax te kãmãnat xop xe xãnãhã', tu: “Xõnnũ te yãytaha', ha 'ãte' mĩy 'amuk xexka, tu tikmũ'ũn xãnãhã put nũ', pãyã' kummuk, tu' nũn 'ohnãg,
pa hõnhã mõg, putat hã mõg, nũy tikmũ'ũn xohix xãnã'.” Kaxĩy.

—Ha putat hã' mõg, tu tikmũ'ũn xohix xãnãhã put nũ', tu tikmũ'ũn max xãnãhã', xix tikmũ'ũn kummuk xãnãhã', yã' xohix xãnãhã', ha' xat'ax yõg mĩptut max ha' mõg tikmũ'ũn xohix, nũy 'ãmuk xexka mã', ha mõktu mĩptut xexka nũ'xĩmnãg.
Ha tik te' xat'ax xexka te hãm'ãta kox hã mõ'nãhã', nũy nũy tikmũ'ũn pẽnã', tu tik puxet pẽnãhã', 'a 'ãmuk xexka yõg topixxax max mõ'tat'ah. Yã mõnãyxop yõg hãpxopmã'ax tat 'õhnãg,
yĩy tik te' xat'ax te: “Tep te xĩy hã mõ'ãnãhã', pa 'ãmuk xexka yõg topixxax mõ'tat hok?” —Ha tik yĩy kĩy ka'ok, tu' yĩy 'õhnãg,
yĩy tik te' xat'ax te kãmãnat xat, tu: “'Ũyĩm kĩy, xi' kup kĩy, tu' putyõn hãpkoxtap kopah, ha' potap-tup, 'ũxũy xexka tu'.” Kaxĩy. 'Ũkux.
Yeyox te hãm'ãktux kux, tu: —Topa te tikmũ'ũn punethok xãnãhã', pak-tõgnãg hã yĩmõgatux. Kaxĩy.
Tik xop te' puknõg yõg gohet 'ãktux
Ha Paniye xop mõg, tu yãy mũtik hãm'ãktux, nũy Yeyox yõg hãm'ãktux'ax hã' yĩkopit, nũy tu' kummugã',

hu yãy tik xop nũ'pok 'Enot xop mũtik, nũy Yeyox tu yĩkopit. Yã tik xop pa max, pãyã' kuxa kummuk, tu: —Notot, yũmũ'ãte 'ãyũmmũg, ha hãpxe'e 'ãktux, tu hãmyũmmũgã max, pu tu tikmũ'ũn Topa yõg hãmputup'ax yũmmũg. Yã tikmũ'ũn 'ũm pu 'ãyĩpkox 'ohnãg, nũy hãpxopmã'ax hitop hã' kopit hok, yĩy yũmũ'ãte 'ãyĩkopit,
hu: Xatep-tep mũn pe'ãpaxex? 'Ok yũmũ yõg xat'ax te' xat hok, pu tayũmak hã pago hok gohet puknõg pu'? 'Ok pe' xat pu pago? Xatep-tep mũn pe'ãpaxex? Kaxĩy.
Tu yã mõ'ãmã', pãyã Yeyox te' yũmmũg, hu: —'Ãxop pa max, pãyã 'ãkuxa mũn kummuk! Tep tuk yĩkopit putup xate'?
Paxnũ tayũmak! Kaxĩy. Ha ta' paxnũn, tu tu' mũg,
yĩy Yeyox te' yĩkopit, hu: —'Ũxuxet'ax nũhũ tik koxuk? Kaxĩy.
Ha: —Yã' puknõg yõg gohet te tikmũ'ũn xat'ax koxuk. Kaxĩy. Yĩy Yeyox te: —Gohet pu' hõm gohet yõg yã hãpxop, xix Topa pu' hõm Topa yõg hãpxop. Kaxĩy.
Ha' xupak, tu' yẽy, tu' yĩkopit kux, tu ta' mõg.
Xanoxeo xop te put pu' hi'ax 'ãktux
Hãpxip 'ĩhã Xanoxeo xop nũn, tu' kuxa mãm 'ohnãg putpu' hi'ax kopah, tu nũktu Yeyox yĩka' nũn,

tu: —Notot, Mõyyex te yũmũ'ã hãmyũmmũgãhã', hu: “Tik 'ũm xok, 'ĩhã' xetut tek-tok put hok, puxix tik taknõy xe' xetut mũy, nũy nũ mũtik yãytax, pu ta tu tuk-tok put, pũyĩk-tok 'ũyĩpxox nõm te mãxap yõg hãpxop pop.” Kaxĩy.
Yã yũmũg tikmũ'ũn kopa' pip taknõy 'ũxohix te' 7 'axa', ha' taknõy nõm hãmãxap te yãytaha', ha' xetut tek-tok put 'ohnãg, ha' yĩpxox xok, ha ta' taknõy tu' kuhmõy te' mũg,

tu nũ mũtik yãytaha', ha' xetut tek-tok put 'ohnãg, ha' yĩpxox xok kamah, ha' taknõy tu' kuhmõy te' mũg, tu nũ mũtik yãytaha', ha mõktu' taknõy xohix te 7 te 'ũn mũtik yãytaha', tu' xok, ha' xetut tek-tok put 'ohnãg.
Yã 'ũn te ka'ax ha' xok kamah.
'Ũtaknõy 'ũm yã 'ũn hã' xetut xe'e'? Pax pu tikmũ'ũn putpu hi, puxi' taknõy 'ũm 'ũxetut mũy? Yã' taknõy xohix te 'ũn mũtik yãytaha'. Yã yãyta xohix. Ta tu' kux. Kaxĩy.
Ha Yeyox te' yãnãn hã hãm'ãktux, hu: —'Ãxop te yã yãy pu mõ'ãmã', 'ap Topa yõg tappet 'ũm yũmmũg'ah, xix Topa yõg hãpka'ok'ax yũmmũg 'ohnãg.
'Ũxakix xop te' putpu' hip-tup, hu ta pexkox yõg nũ'pok xop putuk, tu yã yãyta 'ohnãg.
'Ãte yã xa putpu yãy hi'ax yũmmũgã'ax. 'Ok 'ãxop te Topa yõg tappet 'ũm mõ'kupix hok? Yã Topa te:
“'Ũgmũn yã mõnãyxop 'Amanãm yõg Topa, xix mõnãyxop 'Iyak yõg Topa, xix mõnãyxop Yako yõg Topah.” Kaxĩy. Yã' hi xop mũn hã Topah, pa' xakix xop 'ap hã Topa'ah. Kaxĩy.
Ha tikmũ'ũn te hãmyũmmũg'ax 'ãpak, tu' yẽy.
Topa yõg xat'ax te mãxap
Ha Paniye xop te hãm'ãpak kamah, tu yãy tu nũ' nãhã', 'ĩhã hãmyũmmũg. Yã Yeyox te Xanoxeo xop pu hãm'ãktux hã tu' hupmãhã',
ha Paniye xop yõg tik 'ũm te' xat'ax yũmmũg max, tu Yeyox yõg hãmyũmmũgã'ax yĩkopit putup, hu:
—Notot, pi'yã' mũn 'ũxat'ax xohix hã' mãxap? Kaxĩy.
Ha: —“'Õgnũ Topa mũn putup pax, 'ãkuxa xexka hãp-tup pax, xix 'ãp-tox xexka hãp-tup pax.”
Yã' xat'ax xohix hã' mãxap.
Ha' xat'ax kũnãy tu te' nõy putuk, tu: “'Ãnõy putup pax, xate yãy putup pax putuk.” Kaxĩy.
Yã' xat'ax 2 te Mõyyex yõg xat'ax xohix yũmmũgãhã', ha tik hittap xop te Topa pupi hãm'ãktux, tu' yũmmũgãhã kamah. Kaxĩy.
Yeyox te Topa yõg hãmyãykutnã'ax 'ãktux
Ha Paniye xop te yãykotĩnnãhã', 'ĩhã Yeyox te' yĩkopit, hu:
—'Ãxop tep-tep mũn pe'ãpaxex Topa yõg hãmyãykutnã'ax tu'? Tik 'ũm mũn hã 'ũmõkputox 'õhõm? Kaxĩy. Ha: —Yã mõnãyxop hittap Namix hã' mõkputox. Kaxĩy.
Ha xe' yĩkopit, hu: —Tep tu Topa Koxuk te mõnãyxop hittap Namix pu hãmyũmmũgãhã', puyĩy Topa yõg hãmyãykutnã'ax 'ãktux, hu: “'Ũkxuxyã'.” Kaxĩy.
Yã Namix te: “Topa tek xuxyã pu hãm'ãktux, hu: 'Yũhũm 'ũgyĩm xe'e hã, 'ĩhã 'ãte' gãyxop nõã'.’ ” Kaxĩy.
Yĩy mõnãyxop Namix te hãmyãykutnã'ax pu: “'Ũkxuxyã'.” Kaxĩy. 'Ok yãykutnã'ax yã mõnãyxop Namix hã' mõkputox xe'e'? Kaxĩy.
'Ap yãnãn tu hãm'ãktux yũmmũg'ah, hu' yẽy, tu xep yĩkopit 'ohnãg.
